clips.title: The story
paras: Lakeshire looks to Magistrate Solomon as gnolls and orcs close in. From the town hall, he governs local affairs and pleads with Stormwind for military aid, but the capital is distracted and gives no help.

Magistrate Solomon governs Lakeshire as danger closes around the town. Redridge and Shadowhide gnolls prowl the surrounding hills, while Blackrock orcs descend from the north in organized warbands. Solomon and Marshal Marris work to keep order and muster a defense, but Lakeshire's guards and militia are stretched to their limit.

Magistrate Solomon has sent messengers across the kingdom, pleading for aid from Westfall, Darkshire, and Stormwind. The replies bring little hope. Westfall struggles under the Defias Brotherhood, Duskwood faces its own creeping terrors, and Stormwind City refuses to send troops to the eastern frontier. Lakeshire is left to defend itself.
